672: A samurai living in an era where a samurai is no longer needed. To add to his troubles, oppressive aliens have moved in to invade. Gintoki lives with Kagura and Shinpachi, taking on odd jobs to make the world a better place...and to pay their rent.
673: Shinpachi Shimura works under Gintoki to learn the ways of the samurai. He used to stay at his family's dōjo. However, it seems more like he's just trying to help Gintoki pay the rent than to learn. Shinpachi is the captain of the "Otsu's Imperial Guard," a pop singer's fan club.
674: Although she appears to be a normal, cute, human girl in Chinese-style clothing, she actually belongs to the Yato Clan, one of the strongest and most bloodthirsty of the Amanto races.
1533: Katsura is Gintoki's former comrade during the Joi war. Even after the Amanto take-over of Japan, Katsura continues to resist the Amanto, and has amassed a band of followers.
1759: Sarutobi Ayame is a ninja from the Oniwabanshuu by training, but is currently working as an assassin. She also has a part-time job at the Kunoichi Café.
2282: Okita is the best swordsman in the Shinsengumi. Personality-wise, he tends to be light-hearted and somewhat childish though his speech is heavily deadpan.
2650: Toshiro Hijikata is the famed chain smoking, vice commander of the Shinsengumi so named by his subordinates, because of his fearsome demeanor. Purportedly the brains behind the force, he takes his work seriously, and is fiercely loyal to his leader, Isao Kondo.
2651: Sadaharu has the outward appearance of a giant dog, but is actually an inugami. When sitting on his haunches, he is taller than most humans. He was left in front of Gintoki's apartment in a box that had "To Mr. Freelancer" written on it.
2943: Isao Kondo is the Commander of the Shinsengumi. When not working, he is the stalker of Tae Shimura, earning him the nickname Gorilla-stalker. His superior is Katakuriko Matsudaira, a high-ranking government officer under direct control of the Bakufu.
2944: Tae Shimura is Shinpachi's older sister. She runs the Kakidokan Dojo—which was her father's failing dojo—with her brother. She is usually addressed as "Otae"; the "O" is an honorific used to refer to women. Kagura always addresses her as "big sister" (anego).
2945: Sakamoto is a former member of the Joi. He is a good-natured man and optimistic to the point of being ridiculous, even in the most dangerous situations. His favorite phrase is "AHAHA! It must be _". He also has a tendency to misspell names; he calls Gintoki "Kintoki".
2946: Elizabeth resembles a giant white duck or a giant penguin and is Katsura's companion. Elizabeth was a present from Tatsuma Sakamoto, who presumably picked it up on his travels around space.
2947: He is an assassin and is one of the strongest swordsmen of the Kiheitai, an extremist Joui faction bent on causing world destruction. He regularly keeps his headphones on, as well as sun glasses even while others are talking to him.
2948: A former comrade of Gintoki and Katsura and a major antagonist. He is easily recognisable through his bandaged left eye, his colorful kimono, his eerie smile, and the pipe he is often seen smoking.
2949: Matako Kijima is the only female member of the Kiheitai and is skilled in using a pair of pistols. She is fiercely loyal to Shinsuke Takasugi, and appears to have a crush on him. Her name is roughly based on a samurai of the Bakumatsu era, Kijima Matabei.
2950: A highly skilled ninja who sports a light-brown/dark-blonde mop-top and a goatee.
3760: Hasegawa used to be an official working for the Bakufu, but after an unfortunate incident with Amanto dignitary Prince Hata, whom he was assigned to serve and protect, his superior asked him to succumb to his shame and commit seppuku, hearing that he ran away from his quarters.
4653: Yamazaki is a spy, whose specialty is naturally gathering intelligence. Yamazaki is often caught by Hijikata playing badminton by himself, and he is subsequently beaten. He is often seen cosplaying as a badminton-playing version of Echizen Ryoma from The Prince of Tennis.
5970: Gintoki's landlady. He swore to protect her when he ate food offerings to her dead husband. Her real name is Ayano Terada, Ms. Otose (お登勢 Otose) being a "genji" alias. She was very pretty when she was young and worked at a restaurant.
5972: A high-ranking government officer under direct control of the Bakufu government, Police Superintendent Matsudaira Katakuriko is in charge of the Shinsengumi and the immediate superior of Commander Kondo Isao.
6110: The successor to the Yagyuu family name, the daughter of Koshinori Yagyuu and the granddaughter of Binbokusai Yagyuu.
6187: An idol pop singer whose song lyrics are often very dirty or controversial. She started her career singing on the sides of streets. This was when Shinpachi met her and has followed her ever since, being captain of her fan club.
6225: Ketsuno Christel, more commonly known as Ketsuno Ana, is a popular weather girl and reporter from the Oedo news on whom Sakata Gintoki of the Yorozuya has a major crush.
6451: A mysterious girl who has the power to look into the future, and is respected for the power. She lives with two women who are over protective, so she has little contact with the outside world.
6615: Tama is an android that was found by Gintoki. At the time she was only a disembodied head. She was given her name by Kagura, who was obsessed with eating egg on rice at the time. She is an android maid currently working at Otose's Snack House.
7157: Tokugawa Shige Shige, the Seii taishōgun of Japan. His role in controlling the country is not great because of the passing of his late Father (and the Amanto invasion), so he looked up to Police chief Matsudaira as a sort of father-figure.
7927: Hiraga Gengai is Edo's greatest mechanic and inventor. He has helped Sakata Gintoki and the Yorozuya on several occasions. He makes ugly and crude machines, and his belief is that 'The machines of men are armour, cannons and caterpillars'.
7928: Hedoro is a monster that befriends the Yoruzuya. He is known to love nature and has a bright flower on top of his head, in contrast to his rather ugly face.
7929: Prince Hata is a squat-like, purple alien prince who is fond of animals. His fondness is not reciprocated, and one of his "pets" had even bitten his antenna off (it grew back later).
7930: An amanto who resembles a cat. At first, she seems to be a diligent worker at Otose's snack shop who is trying to support her family, but soon reveals herself to be a thief. Despite this, Otose hired her again after she was released from prison.
8282: Tojou is Kyubei's servant, who is extremely dedicated, if not obsessive, in his concern for his young master. He generally speaks in a very polite manner, using -masu and -desu instead of the short dictionary forms usually employed in a normal male-speech.
8734: The Spirit of Lake Toya possess the sword that Gintoki carries. Appearing in Chapter 150, he attempted to teach the Yorozuya an ultimate technique, the "Jumbolic Magnum," which sends the target flying into the sky with a single punch.
9515: Owner of a ramen restaurant. She had a deep grudge against Joi participants, as her husband was killed by terrorism. Katsura worked at her restaurant when he was injured and hid from the Shinsengumi. He repaid her favour by helping her during a crisis.
9534: A blind hitokiri working for Takasugi. He seeks to destroy everything in the world, similar to Takasugi. His level of swordsmanship is such that he can slash an opponent without the latter seeing him unsheathing his sword.
9535: Henpeita Takechi serves as the strategist of the Kiheitai, does not participate in much physical fighting. He is a self-proclaimed feminist, which he claims is the reason for his gentle treatment of women and children.
9876: Umibouzu is Kagura and Kamui's father and one of the last members of the Yato clan. Like Kagura, he fights using an umbrella but is also shown to be strong in his own right.
9877: A homeless man who wears large glasses and an orange cap without pants. He seems to have many talents, including badminton. He's very similar to Hasegawa in that they are both often seen doing various oddjobs. Musashi has the eyes of a Samurai.
10645: Also known as Hanano Ana, Hanano Saki is a news reporter from Oedo TV who has interviewed characters such as the Yorozuya, Shinsengumi, Katsura etc.
11458: Ito is an advisor to the Shinsengumi. Itou is roughly based on Itou Kashitarou of the Shinsengumi.
12161: Mutsu is the merchant fleet Kaientai's 2nd in Command, but is de facto the one running the company. This is because her "natural idiot" leader Sakamoto Tatsuma is always going MIA (missing in action).
12946: Kamui is a member of the Yato Tribe, the son of Umibouzu and older brother of Kagura. His excellent fighting skills helped him become Captain of the 7th Division of Harusame's Thunder Guns, the most powerful combat unit within the Harusame group and Overlord of Yoshiwara.
15146: Mitsuba is Sougo's older sister, and took care of him since their parents passed away when they were children. Sougo cares deeply for Mitsuba, and is uncharacteristically polite and docile when around her.
15452: Original Creator of Gintama, appears sometimes in the manga/anime as a lazy gorilla.
15580: He is the grand patriarch of the Yagyuu Family. He is the sword master to Yagyuu Kyuubei.
17244: The founder and leader of the Sket Dan, nicknamed Bossun (ボッスン). Bossun is known for his enthusiasm for helping others solve their problems and is quite idealistic.
17245: Himeko is the violent "yankee"-girl with a soft spot for cute things. She is the fighter/brawn and tsukkomi to the Sket Dan. In her past she was called "Legendary Yankee Onihime (鬼姫)" which became a symbol of "power and fear".
17246: Switch is the brains and secretary of the Sket Dan. As a result of the events that happened in his life, he opts to speak through a voice synthesizer on his computer. He has a deadpan sense of humor and seems to enjoy teasing others.
18016: Murata Tetsuko is a swordsmith in Edo. She is the daughter of renowned swordsmith Jintetsu Murata, and younger sister of Tetsuya Murata, both of which are deceased. She has helped Gintoki and the Yorozuya on several occasions.
18030: Shinpachi's friend from childhood, who was always bullied. Later, he joined local gang, just to prove that he is strong now. After catching him stealing, Shinpachi takes him under his care, and now Taka-chin is official member of Otsuu- chan's fanclub.
18823: Tsukuyo is a blonde-haired woman with a scar over her forehead and left cheek. One of the better known Hundred Blooms of Yoshiwara, a law enforcement squad of Yoshiwara that consists of all females, deployed by the Night King Hosen.
22551: Taka-tin is a foreigner who replaces Taka-chin after he is hospitalized in the contest to become Otsu-chan's Official Fan Club. He speaks with an American accent unless he's saying an otsu suffix. His weapon of choice is French​ bread.
23618: An Amanto from the planet Speed. She must keep moving to feel the wind or she will die.
25666: Hosen is from the Yato Clan, he's the boss of Yoshiwara and ex-leader of the 7th division of pirate group Harusen. In the past he fought against Umibouzu for three days straight and tied.
26731: A veteran member of the Yato clan. He supports and travels with Kamui. Abuto treasures his own kind, those of Yato blood and dislikes fighting them, though it goes against his blood-thirsty Yato nature.
27892: Jiraia (real name Danzou Tobita) is the most feared ninja in all the lands. He was the strongest man in the Oniwabanshu, the one who created the Hyakka, the founder and chief of the Hundred Blooms as well as Tsukuyo's master. He was born in the countryside to Iga samurai.
28144: Mentor to the Old Jouishishi members in their youth. Trained Sakata Gintoki, Katsura Kotarou and Takasugi Shinsuke in swordskills and the bushido. He died before the Gintama storyline started.
29241: The main character in episode 188, gives a presentation in class about meeting and befriending Madao (Hasegawa). Daigorou is a parody of the character in the Manga Lone Wolf and Cub (notice the similarity of their looks). Both of them also share the same first name.
30306: Gedoumaru is a Shikigami of the Ketsuno Clan. She was given to Sakata Gintoki of the Yorozuya as a precaution, during the Exorcist Chapter, by Ketsuno Ana, who had requested the Yorozuya's assistance.
30641: She was one of the objects of the Pandemonium-eating contest held in episode 197. Shinpachi had to eat her.
30643: Ketsuno Seimei is the current head of the Ketsuno clan. He is a genius and is considered to be the strongest onmyoji in the clan's entire history. He is also the brother of Ketsuno Christel.
31501: Nakamura Kyoujirou was a stray dog picked up by the leader of the Mashiroi yakuza group. Believed to be the villain in the story but in fact has a very kind heart. In episodes 107-108
32122: An orphan rescued by the Chief Fireman. The Chief was unable to save her parents in time, and the guilt compelled him to raise Tatsumi as his own daughter. Her ambition to become a fireman the guardian she met with strong opposition from her guardian.
32153: Daughter of paranoid father Matsudaira Katakuriko.
32205: Mother and managing agent to Pop Idol Terakado Tsuu
32209: Kondou's supporter. Moved to tears by macho yakuza movies like Alien vs Yakusa parody of Alien vs Predator
32214: Younger sister of Tokugawa Shigeshige. Spent a day with Kagura, after she sneaked out of the palace due to boredom and loneliness. She surprisingly got hooked on sukonbu, thanks to Kagura's influence. After her father died, Rotten Maizou takes care of her as her guardian.
32230: She is the target of Sakamoto Tatsuma's infatuation. Shimura Tae's colleague at Snack Smile.
32231: Twin sister (younger) of Ane, the ex-priestess is a self-professed NEET (Not currently engaged in Employment, Education or Training). Felt guilty about abandoning Sadaharu.

32233: Peacock Princess Kada was one of the four emperors that ruled the Kabuki District. A skilled professional gambler herself, she operated most of the gambling outfits in Kabuki District.
32234: Self-proclaimed King of Kabuki District's; is a bully and a Rhinoceros beetle aficionado. His opposite number, Queen of Kabuki District's; is Kagura.
32238: Yoshiwara Paradise's No.1 courtesan. Mother of Seita. Unable to walk, paralyzed by Housen in order to stop her repeated escape attempts.
32239: Seita is the adopted son of Hinowa and the biological son of a courtesan of Yoshiwara, who died after giving birth. As a baby, he was led to the outside world in the care of an old man by Hinowa. As described by Otose, he is clever, honest and learns quickly.
32259: The Leukocyte King (白血球王, hakkekkyuu ou) is a part of the antivirus system Tama uses to defend her system. According to Tama, king is based on the strongest person she knows, which is Gintoki. He looks exactly like Gintoki.
32275: Father of Saigou Teruhiko 西郷 てる彦 and owner of okama club by the name of 「かまっ娘倶楽部」kamakko club, Saigou Tokumori himself dresses as a woman.
32277: Transvestite who works in the host club 「かまっ娘倶楽部」kamakko (this club is owned by Tokumori Saigou).
32656: Tamo-san is Gintama's version of the real-life Japanese comedian Tamori-san.
32728: Kaoru is a ninja and a member of the Shinobi 5, a mercenary ninja group for hire. She is familiar with Zenzo, and attended his father's funeral.
32737: Partner of Honjou Kyoushirou. Previously known as Hanako 花子, before cosmetic surgery.
32739: A gang boss who lives his life with one rule. That rule is everything in life has a 7:3 ratio.
32837: He likes to eat kid's meals.
32838: Big Boss of the Kabuki District yakuza syndicate Dobunezumi Group His henchmen mentioned that Doromizu Jirochou, used to admire Otose, one of the other 4 Devas of Kabuki District.
32839: Kozenigata's sidekick. In episodes 84-85 it's not stated if Haji is a girl or a boy, despite in his/her picture he/she seems to have a bust.
32956: Daughter of a well-connected Bakufu official's family, Hasegawa Taizou 長谷川 泰三, who was from a poorer samurai needed family, married into her family.
33953: She is a ghost working at the Senbokyo hot spring.
36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.

45311: An Onmyouji and head of the Shirino clan.
47541: A strange girl who lives in a cursed Blu-ray disk.
49501: A parody character based off Cell from the Dragonball Z series.
49563: Lord Beida is the evil emperor of the Renhou's clan.
49565: Fumiko was Elizabeth's girlfriend and is also a Renhou.
55577: Imai Nobume is a vice captain and part of the assassination unit of Mimawarigumi. She is emotionless in her facial expression and speech. She is sadistic and likes to cut people down.
55579: Sasaki Isaburo is the commander of Mimawarigumi. His character is based on the leader of the real Mimawarigumi, Sasaki Tadasaburo. Sasaki Isaburo was born into the elite samurai family Sasaki, as the main heir. He is also the half brother to Sasaki Tetsunosuke.
56029: Half brother of Mimawarigumi commander Sasaki Isaburo.
57337: He is a machine made by Gengai, originally meant to be Gintoki's perfect substitute while he was away.
72323: Oboro is the current leader of the Tensho School and the strongest assassin within the Naraku organisation. Trained in the Tensho school and later succeeding the previous generation's head position.
77717: The former 13th generation Shogun of Edo in the Gintama world. He is also the uncle and advisor to the current Shogun Tokugawa Shige Shige and Soyo Hime.
80065: Obi Hajime is the former head coach of the Koudoukan. In his time in Koudoukan, he studied under Shimura Ken and was noted to be a sword genius throughout Edo. At a young age, he became the head coach of Koudoukan and he taught both Otae and Shinpachi.

124135: Utsuro is the founder of the Tendoshu and was also the first leader of the Naraku Faction before Oboro.
124308: A member of the Yato tribe. She was the wife of Umibouzu, and the mother of Kagura and Kamui. She is also born by the Altana of a planet like Utsuro. And her planet is Kouan
161215: Hitotsubashi Nobunobu is the head of the Hitotsubashi faction.
174748: She was the 17th Ikeda Yaemon of the Ikeda Clan, and the adopted daughter of 16th Yaemon, as well as the adoptive sister of the 18th Ikeda Yaemon. She was branded as a traitor by the clan after she killed the 16th Yaemon.

203955: Tennousei Hankai is the leader and only member of the 3rd Division of the Harusame pirates known for his chessmaster skills and trickery.

208329: Shijaku is an admiral of an unspecified nation, who joined Altana Liberation Army and became one of its leaders.
233013: Enshou was the warrior prince of Burei, known as "The Gunpowder Prince". Following the Altana incident that destroyed his home planet, he joined the Altana Liberation Army and became one of its alliance leaders alongside Shijaku.
265035: An Old Jouishishi and one of the comrades of Sakata Gintoki, Katsura Kotarou, Sakamoto Tatsuma and Takasugi Shinsuke during the Joui Wars. Kurokono and the Joui 4 fought countless of battles in the Joui wars.
